svg.data-spec:
title: funcd architecture kind: flow
[Outside] gray right cli: funcdctl callers: Callers | HTTP [/]
[funcd] purple right [Control plane] teal down api: API | authn authz: Authorization | RBAC admission: Admission | mutate, validate ctrl: Controller | a reconciler per kind [/] [Data plane] blue down edge: Edge | TLS, routes, limits invoke: Invoke chain | contract checks act: Activator | wakes a worker [Executor] blue down workers: Workers | process or containerd local: Local API | a socket per worker around: Egress, volumes, logs [/] [Services] green kvsvc: KV | Badger blobsvc: Blob | files or S3 rqlitesvc: rqlite | SQL databases lakesvc: Lake | DuckDB natssvc: NATS | internal bus [/] [/] [/]
[Storage layer] coral right meta: Metastore @db evstore: Event store @db runstate: Run state @db [/]
cli > api > authz > admission > ctrl ctrl > edge: routes ctrl > workers: desired state callers > edge > invoke > act > workers workers > local local > Services funcd > Storage layer
